title: Every prime divides a term of OEIS A363414
description: Let a(n) = Im(prod_{k=0..n} (1 + 2k i))/2 (OEIS A363414). Peter Bala conjectured that every prime divides some term a(n) with n > 0. We prove that p divides a(p-1) for every odd prime p, and a(3) = -18: reversing the order of the factors shows that the product is congruent to its complex conjugate modulo p. The proof is formalized in Lean 4 with Mathlib against the statement OeisA363414.conjecture_type1_empty of Google DeepMind's Formal Conjectures repository. The repository contains the paper (LaTeX source and PDF), the Lean files, a check script, exact checks and logs.
